video_title: YouTube title: Spurs Media: 1-on-1 with Devin Vassell

quotes.speaker: Devin Vassell
quotes.summary_phrase: Devin Vassell on Tobias Harris joining the Spurs roster
quotes.excerpt: Tobias is the vet now coming into this team. He's fit seamlessly.
quotes.quote: There is a new trend of bringing in vets into the rosters to help mold some things and Tobias is the vet now coming into this team. What have I seen from him? Just the start, his voice and his leadership of being around the league, being in positions where he's won, he's been on winning teams, he's been in the playoffs. Just hearing some of the insight that he has on some of the little stuff and the nuances, I'm excited for him to really learn the system and learn our organization, but for the most part he's fit seamlessly.

quotes.speaker: Devin Vassell
quotes.summary_phrase: Devin Vassell on the physical development of young Spurs players
quotes.excerpt: All of our young guys are taking another step when it comes to their bodies.
quotes.quote: I'm not going to say any specific person, but I think all of our young guys are taking another step when it comes to their bodies, taking care of their bodies, being locked in on the court and just learning from last year. All of our young guys are ready to go and it's exciting.

quotes.speaker: Devin Vassell
quotes.summary_phrase: Devin Vassell on his defensive growth and team expectations
quotes.excerpt: The coaches challenged me this past year of being a presence on the defensive end.
quotes.quote: The coaches challenged me this past year of being a presence on the defensive end and establishing that and just trusting my instincts. I think I did that a lot last year and during the playoffs. It doesn't really matter about anything else but winning. And so that was the formula of me just playing as hard as I can on both ends of the floor and getting stops.

quotes.speaker: Devin Vassell
quotes.summary_phrase: Devin Vassell on the resilience of the Spurs team
quotes.excerpt: The resilience of the team that we played for them to win those four games.
quotes.quote: The resilience of the team that we played for them to win those four games, we were up a lot of those games and for them to come back and win, it showed how resilient they are and that just goes, we have to have that. We took the lead and we were confident, but at the end of the day, it wasn't enough. So we got to learn from that and there's going to be tough times in the season where we got to be resilient, we got to fight back.

quotes.speaker: Devin Vassell
quotes.summary_phrase: Devin Vassell on Chris Paul's role as a veteran leader
quotes.excerpt: He's the vet on our team, especially in that lineup, closing the games.
quotes.quote: He's the vet on our team, especially in that lineup, closing the games. Being able to calm the team down, being able to hit the tough shots, being able to hit the good ones, get us a good look. He was steady through the whole year and that's what you need when you're relying on your point guard. To come into the Spurs, being basically his number one option the whole time and then coming here where we have Vic and then a bunch of other people who can score the basketball, he had to adapt to that and I'm excited for him. He had a whole year under his belt, had a healthy off-season. I think he's going to prove a lot of people wrong.
